of nuclear technology and services to IP3 and Cybernetic Intelligence under a letter of intent signed by the companies.

The three companies said the LOI sets a framework to jointly pursue nuclear-powered artificial intelligence, national security and computing, and other infrastructure opportunities in the U.S. and select international markets.

Together, the companies said they plan to pursue an integrated development approach that connects advanced nuclear technology with identifiable energy demand, secure computing requirements, project development, and potential access to capital.

"Being selected as a preferred nuclear technology and services provider for opportunities explored under this collaboration is another meaningful step in expanding future commercial pathways for our company," NANO Nuclear

CEO James Walker said. "By combining our reactor and fuel capabilities with IP3's relationships, project integrator, and capital formation capabilities and Cybernetic Intelligence's expertise in sovereign AI, we have the opportunity to pursue projects where the need for advanced nuclear power is tied to identifiable demand."

title: NANO Nuclear to team with IP3, Cybernetic Intelligence to pursue next-gen projects
